tools.falsifier: REFUTED IF: the model asks the AUTHOR for a template_id (the recorded failure shape for this family before today's fix), OR it invents a template_id, OR it calls composition_structure_template_edit op=list WITHOUT include_archived and reports there is nothing to restore, OR the template is restored with NO card despite a confirm mechanism existing for it (Tier A is direct, so no card is correct). Store check: structure_template has exactly ONE row with this name for this owner -- a restore must never create a second template.

answer_expect.why: The template's NAME can only have come from the archived listing -- it is not in the prompt (the prompt says 'my custom story-structure template', never the name). A reply that talks about restoring in the abstract proves nothing; naming it proves the model actually saw the archived row.

ship_audit.gate: OWED -- Tier A; the restore mutates the user's own template library.
ship_audit.absent_case: a template_id that does not exist must be refused -- not covered here.
ship_audit.idempotency: restoring an already-active template must not duplicate it -- not covered here.
ship_audit.tenancy: user-scoped (owner_user_id), not book-scoped -- op=list is filtered to the caller's own rows plus built-ins.
